usedFor: Shopify sees the shopper who left and Outlook is where you write to them. “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify can run “Create Draft Email”, so a follow-up waits in your drafts instead of going out unseen.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Draft Email” in Microsoft Outlook
bestTemplate.why: Abandoned checkout carries the shopper's email or phone, and a draft means a person reads the message before it reaches a customer.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it runs on a schedule and the draft can be late. A checkout with a phone number but no email gives the draft no address.
